methodology: Sequential Release runs from copied source projects with unique intermediates/binaries and the immutable actual-source-json-v1 resource snapshot. Aggregate timed instrumentation is a separate copied assembly; timing comparisons use uninstrumented baseline versus memoized copy.
proposal: Cold per-trace/per-source-junction tri-state memo; invalidate before every candidate BuildTrace and every stationary snapshot mutation. Each miss retains the original complete start/end/tail/receipt query and route-bound/self-crossing validation.
